reason: L1 self-attack before the control wave: v1's 13 mutants and 4 rewrites are fixed public strings, so a selftest that greps its own runner for exactly those strings (a shortcut keyed on the counter's fixture labels) would meet v1 without testing the tally. v2 adds a held-out set drawn by a frozen generator seeded with the measured commit id, plus a generator sanity check against the pristine harness. No control, fix or data seat had run when this amendment was written.
predicate: C1_R30_PASS is true iff, on tools/mutate-and-run.sh at REV, (a) the pristine runner's --selftest exits 0 and prints `VERDICT: PASS`; (b) the pristine tally block, run under the fixed-status harness, gives PASS/exit 0 for all-zero statuses, FAIL/exit 1 for each of the 9 single-leg status-1 vectors and SETUP/exit 2 for each of the 9 single-leg status-2 vectors (19/19); (c) each of the 9 drop mutants (one operand removed from the tally loop) is refused at run time: under the harness, for the all-zero vector and for the vector whose dropped leg has status 1, it neither exits 0 nor prints `REGRESSION: PASS` (refused_drops == 9); (d) --selftest exits non-zero (or times out) on each of the 13 family mutants (9 drops + 4 arm mutants) (killed == 13); (e) --selftest exits 0 with `VERDICT: PASS` on each of the 4 frozen semantics-preserving rewrites of the tally block (equiv_pass == 4); (f) --selftest exits non-zero (or times out) on each of the 12 held-out mutants drawn by heldout() with seed int(REV, 16) (heldout_killed == 12); (g) --selftest exits 0 with `VERDICT: PASS` on each of the 4 held-out equivalent rewrites drawn by the same generator (heldout_equiv == 4).
counter_error: exit 2 and PASS false when a replacement site is not found exactly once, or when a held-out mutant is harness-equivalent to the pristine block, or a held-out rewrite differs from it

before.value: pristine_selftest=1 harness=19/19 refused_drops=0/9 killed=0/13 equiv_pass=4/4 heldout_killed=0/12 heldout_equiv=4/4

target: PREDICATE: C1_R30_PASS=true at the landed lane head
controls_required_before_data: contract.json list K1-K6 plus K7: a selftest keyed on v1's literal mutant strings and rewrite markers (scored against v2)
unchanged: axis, surface, routed_by, sourced_on, design_constraint, kill_rule, hold_rule, no_harm_monitors, round_order of contract.json
